verdict.rationale: Kick documents an MCP server/CLI letting AI query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping, and states it works with any MCP-compatible assistant, but explicitly notes actions require 'your approval,' and there is no evidence of a full public API/OpenAPI spec — the openapi probe returned 404s across all candidate paths. Many UI-surfaced workflows (invoicing, bill pay, multi-entity splits, rules creation, reconciliation) are never confirmed as MCP/CLI-accessible, only UI-documented. missing for 10: documented full REST/GraphQL API or OpenAPI spec, confirmation that all UI actions (invoicing, bill pay, multi-entity, rules) are exposed via API/MCP, and evidence of unattended (non-approval-gated) automation.
